PORT.description: HTTP port (nginx reverse-proxies to backend on 8080).

TA_HOST.description: Public URL of this service — auto-derived from Railway domain.

TA_USERNAME.description: Initial admin username. Change after first login.

TA_PASSWORD.description: Initial admin password — auto-generated. Save after deploy.

ELASTIC_PASSWORD.description: Elasticsearch password — auto-generated. Must match ES service password.

ES_URL.description: Elasticsearch connection URL — auto-derived from ES companion.

REDIS_CON.description: Redis connection URL — auto-derived from Redis companion.

HOST_UID.description: User ID for volume file ownership.

HOST_GID.description: Group ID for volume file ownership.

POT_PROVIDER_URL.description: POT-token provider URL for yt-dlp — auto-derived from POT companion.

ELASTIC_PASSWORD.description: Elasticsearch password — shared from main service.

PORT.description: HTTP port for the bgutil-ytdlp-pot-provider server.
